name: Betrayal at House on the Hill (2nd edition)

categories.label: Heroes won
categories.hint: Tick if the heroes met their haunt win condition; otherwise the traitor side won.

winCondition: No points. After the haunt starts, each haunt scenario in the Traitor's Tome / Secrets of Survival books states its own win condition for the heroes and for the traitor; the side that fulfils it wins.

roles.label: Heroes
roles.winCondition: Fulfil the heroes' objective in the active haunt scenario.

roles.label: Traitor (and monsters)
roles.winCondition: Fulfil the traitor's objective in the active haunt scenario.

endCondition.description: Game ends when one side meets its haunt-specific win condition.

notes: family: hidden-traitor. Per-haunt (50 scenarios) win conditions are not modelled; record which side won. Official rulebook text not retrieved; based on general description (Wikipedia) and known game structure.
